learning_objective: 🎯 Become a master sentence builder by using magical joining words to connect your ideas together!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Conjunctions are like sticky glue for grammar! They join two words, two groups of words, or two short sentences together to make one big, beautiful sentence.
We use 'and' to join similar ideas together, like 'I like apples AND bananas.' We use 'or' when we have to make a choice, like 'Do you want tea OR coffee?'
We use 'but' to show a difference or opposite idea: 'I ran fast, BUT I missed the bus.' We use 'because' to give a reason: 'I am smiling BECAUSE I am happy!'

fun_activity.title: 🧩 The Sentence Fixer
fun_activity.instructions: Take these two short sentences: 'It was raining.' 'I opened my umbrella.' Use the magic conjunction 'so' or 'because' to join them into one perfect sentence!

quick_recap: ⭐ Conjunctions are joining words that connect ideas and sentences.
⭐ 'And' adds things together, while 'Or' gives you a choice.
⭐ 'But' shows a contrasting idea, and 'Because' explains the reason why!
